primary_metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations by source package (pinned snapshot)
uncertainty: One verified C SQL path after a bounded Debian popcon source-name search (names containing 'sql', first 100 of 229 by rank) plus targeted lookups, captured 2026-11-17 from the pinned popcon snapshot. libpg_query 18.1.0 (Debian source libpg-query, 41 installations) parses both valid controls with the PostgreSQL 18 grammar into a parse tree that gives the oracle summary. sqlite3, sqlcipher and postgresql-18 rank higher but are engines or a server without a library syntax-tree API. libgda5 (2,105; GdaSqlParser) ranks higher and qualifies on documentation but was not run in this round, so this is not a top-ten ranking. The popcon count is very small and reflects packaged installs, not use of the library through language bindings. Two valid controls establish only the tested dialect-neutral subset.
